summary: AIR Global PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting full settlement on September 10, 2026 of a May 11, 2026 forward purchase agreement with Harraden Circle entities covering 5,000,000 CAEP Class A shares exchanged into Company ordinary shares at the CAEP business combination close. Harraden sold 2,970 shares on-market, remitting $31,152.02, and returned the remaining 4,997,030 recycled shares, which the Company cancelled on receipt. No price, premium or advisor was disclosed. The cancellation reduces share count, functioning as a repurchase; watch actual post-settlement share count, possible further forward unwinds, and any buyback authorization or liquidity effect.
